verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no simulated-conversation or eval tooling for testing agents before they take real phone calls. The A/B testing item compares two configurations on live traffic using conversion, CSAT or containment metrics, which is production experimentation rather than pre-deployment testing. InjectAgentMessage and the Browser Agent SDK are only building blocks a developer could use to assemble their own test harness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls
